author: Jasmin De Freitas
content: So thrilled with our Dancing Cubs experience! I booked the Jungle Soft Play Package and the Green and Gold Ball Pond for my son’s “Wild One” first birthday party, and we were so pleased with our rentals. Prior to the party, Zara and the team were very professional and responsive (including last minute requests from my party venue for paperwork). The crew that dropped off/set up the soft play were really friendly and helpful. Everything was very clean and in excellent condition.  And most importantly, the kids really loved playing with everything! We would definitely book again for future events!
